# CLAUDE.md — Mimic Keep

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2 stable, `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf` (README.md:18);
  `godot/project.godot:16` lists the feature tags `"4.7"` and `"Forward Plus"`.
- **Renderer:** Forward+, the default, so the editor drops `rendering_method` (commit ccb9529; a probe reads
  `forward_plus`). 2D filter nearest (godot/project.godot:53); no HDR 2D key (:51-53), so it is off.
- **Viewport:** 1280×720, stretch mode `canvas_items` (godot/project.godot:20-22).
- **Main scene:** `res://game/main.tscn` (godot/project.godot:15). Root `Main` (Node2D,
  script `game/main.gd`); scarecrows are added under `World/Enemies` (godot/game/main.tscn:9-21).
  The scene has no Light2D or CanvasModulate node (godot/game/main.tscn:1-63).

### The shaded object: the Straw Scarecrow sprite
- Scene `godot/game/scarecrow.tscn`: root `Scarecrow` (Node2D, script `res://game/scarecrow.gd`)
  with one child `Sprite` of type **Sprite2D**, texture `res://assets/sprites/scarecrow.png`
  (godot/game/scarecrow.tscn:15-18). Its material is a local-to-scene ShaderMaterial on
  `res://shaders/burning_tint.gdshader` (godot/game/scarecrow.tscn:8-10), driven by
  `res://game/burning_tint.gd` on the Sprite.
- No script draws it: `scarecrow.gd` has no `_draw()` (godot/game/scarecrow.gd:1-74).
- Instances are created by `Game.spawn_scarecrow()`, which instantiates `SCARECROW_SCENE` and
  adds it to `enemies` (godot/game/main.gd:10, 51-57). Every instance shares the one scene file,
  so a material set in `scarecrow.tscn` is shared unless made local or duplicated
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Rule 6).
- The sprite PNG is written by `godot/tools/make_sprites.gd` (README.md:81).

### Game state that drives the effect
- Owner: `godot/game/scarecrow.gd` (class `Scarecrow`, godot/game/scarecrow.gd:1-6).
  - `var burn_time_left: float = 0.0` (line 16); `is_burning()` is `burn_time_left > 0.0` (lines 25-26).
  - `signal burning_started` / `burning_ended` (lines 8-9). `ignite()` sets `burn_time_left =
    Tuning.BURN_DURATION`, emitting `burning_started` only if not already burning (lines 42-46).
  - Counted down in `_physics_process(delta)`; at or below `BURN_END_EPSILON` (1e-9, line 13) it is set
    to 0.0 and `burning_ended` is emitted (lines 49-62, CHANGE-BRIEF revision "boundary exception"),
    so it follows `Engine.time_scale` and stops when paused.
  - On death: `died` is emitted and the node is `queue_free()`d (lines 70-74).
- Constants: `BURN_DURATION := 4.0`, `BURN_DPS := 4.0` (godot/game/tuning.gd:22-23).

### 3D object for the textured shader
- Scene `godot/showcase/shield_room.tscn`. Nodes `ShieldA` (lines 49-52) and `ShieldB`
  (lines 59-62), both MeshInstance3D with `mesh = res://showcase/shield_mesh.tres` (line 3).
- Each node's `surface_material_override/0` is a ShaderMaterial file (lines 4-5):
  `res://showcase/shield_new.tres` on ShieldA and `res://showcase/shield_burned.tres` on ShieldB,
  both on Rui's `res://shaders/shield_wood.gdshader`. Their values and textures are listed in
  `godot/MATERIALS.md`. The mesh resource itself declares no material
  (godot/showcase/shield_mesh.tres:1-14).
- Hint experiment: `godot/showcase/hint_experiment.tscn`, two unshaded quads with
  `hint_source_color.tres` and `hint_raw.tres` on Rui's `res://shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader`.
- Mesh source: `godot/tools/make_shield_mesh.gd` writes `res://showcase/shield_mesh.tres`
  (line 7, 44); front face has planar UVs over 0..1 (line 3) and tangents are generated (line 41).
- Lighting: DirectionalLight3D `Sun`, energy 1.2, shadows on (lines 35-38); Environment ambient 0.3,
  `tonemap_mode = 0` (Linear) (lines 7-13); Camera3D at (0, 0.65, 2.3), fov 45 (lines 40-43).

### Tests — always through scripts/run-test.sh
`scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps>` runs
`timeout 120 godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/<file> --fixed-fps <fps>`, tees
to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`, and exits 1 if the log contains `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR`
(scripts/run-test.sh:1-9). It uses relative paths, so run it from the repository root.

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --import    # once after a fresh clone or a deleted godot/.godot (README.md:57)
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_input.gd 60
```
Existing tests run at 60 fps; the new effect test at 30, 60 and 144 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Rule 2).
- `godot/tests/test_rules.gd`: game rules through the real main scene, one PASS/FAIL line per check,
  exit 1 on failure (lines 1-4, 34-35); `test_input.gd`: real keys via `Input.parse_input_event` (1-4, 46-52).
- Baseline: test_rules 23/0, test_input 14/0 at 60 fps through run-test.sh
  (evidence/baseline/test_rules_60fps.log, evidence/baseline/test_input_60fps.log; commit 29ebc5b).
- Added in Assignment 5: `test_burning_tint.gd` (the tint), `normal_map_check.gd` (curl check,
  threshold from CHANGE-BRIEF revision C) and `test_materials.gd` (the material audit).

### Headless facts (probed on this machine, Godot 4.7.2, 2026-10-26/27)
- A headless run uses `DisplayServer` "headless" with an empty video adapter: a dummy renderer
  that draws nothing. No headless test can judge how anything looks.
- `Shader.get_shader_uniform_list()` reports each uniform's name, type and hint headlessly, but
  not its default (null from the material and from RenderingServer): read defaults from source text.
  A shader that fails to parse prints `SHADER ERROR` and reports an empty list.
- `set_shader_parameter()` with an undeclared name raises no error and reads back the stored value.
- `instance uniform`s are missing from `get_shader_uniform_list()` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Rule 6).
- Physics runs at 60 ticks/s whatever `--fixed-fps` says; `rendering/viewport/hdr_2d` is false.
- `shield_mesh.tres` has UV and tangent arrays (surface format flags).
- `godot` on PATH is a shim in `~/bin` (outside the repo) to the portable 4.7.2 console build.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by the human (Rui) and are never edited by an agent —
not created, modified, renamed, reformatted or deleted. If a shader looks wrong, report it and stop.
`scripts/check-session.sh` verifies after each session that `godot/shaders/` and
`scripts/run-test.sh` are unchanged (scripts/check-session.sh:29-33).

## Out of scope

- Anything that alters gameplay: HP, burn duration or damage, the burn timer, movement,
  targeting, firing, arrows and hit detection, collision, gate damage, spawning, win/loss,
  pause/restart, input actions. Presentation code may only *read* `burn_time_left`,
  `is_burning()` and the two signals; nothing may write back into game state.
- Editing `godot/game/tuning.gd`, `main.gd`, `archer.gd`, `arrow.gd`, `godot/tests/test_rules.gd`,
  `godot/tests/test_input.gd`, or `scripts/run-test.sh`. Changing or loosening any existing
  test expectation.
- Using `TIME` or a frame count to decide how long the tint lasts.
- Using an `instance uniform` for `burn_mix`, or sharing one ShaderMaterial between scarecrows.
- Tinting any object other than the scarecrow sprite (archer, arrows, Mimi, background, HUD).
- Changing the shield room's light, environment, camera or mesh during the A/B material comparison.
- GDD systems not in this change (gold, XP, level-ups, shop, other elements, bosses) (README.md:131-138).

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists, so this file has no `@AGENTS.md` line.
- Rui's shaders: `burning_tint.gdshader` (commit 6a2c298), `shield_wood.gdshader` (416e5f5;
  `normal_strength` corrected after the audit, 822d27a), `hint_experiment.gdshader` (f76bb03).
- The driver is not named in the brief; it is `godot/game/burning_tint.gd` on the Sprite (session 2).
- (Now observed.) A `source_color` uniform is not linearised in a canvas_item shader with HDR 2D off:
  at `burn_mix` 1.0 the pixels are exactly (255, 192, 32) (evidence/controlled_values/pixels.txt).
- Shield UVs cover 0..1 on the front face only; back and rim differ (make_shield_mesh.gd:25, 38-40).

3	set -o pipefail
4	mkdir -p logs
5	if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
6		fps_args=(); tag="realtime"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p logs
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
log="logs/$(basename "$1" .gd)_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" godot --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path godot --script "res://tests/$1" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

1	class_name Scarecrow
2	extends Node2D
3	## Straw Scarecrow: walks down to the wall and hits the gate. Straw burns.
4	## Owns the Burning state: burn_time_left > 0 means burning. Fire refreshes it to the full
5	## BURN_DURATION (a second hit does not stack damage). Timed in physics time, so it follows
6	## Engine.time_scale and stops while the tree is paused.
7	
8	signal burning_started
9	signal burning_ended
10	signal died
11	signal attacking_gate(amount: float)
12	
13	const BURN_END_EPSILON := 1e-9      # s; float residue below this counts as burnt out
14	
15	var hp: float = Tuning.SCARECROW_HP
16	var burn_time_left: float = 0.0
17	var at_wall := false
18	
19	
20	func _ready() -> void:
21		add_to_group("enemies")
22		at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y
23	
24	
25	func is_burning() -> bool:
26		return burn_time_left > 0.0
27	
28	
29	func is_dead() -> bool:
30		return hp <= 0.0
31	
32	
33	func hit(damage: float, element: StringName) -> void:
34		if is_dead():
35			return
36		hp -= damage
37		if element == &"fire":
38			ignite()
39		_check_death()
40	
41	
42	func ignite() -> void:
43		var was_burning := is_burning()
44		burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION
45		if not was_burning:
46			burning_started.emit()
47	
48	
49	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
50		if is_dead() or is_queued_for_deletion():   # a reset in the same tick must not hit the gate
51			return
52		if is_burning():
53			var burned := minf(delta, burn_time_left)
54			hp -= Tuning.BURN_DPS * burned
55			burn_time_left -= delta
56			# Summing 240 deltas of 1/60 leaves ~1e-14 instead of 0, which used to add a 241st tick.
57			if burn_time_left <= BURN_END_EPSILON:
58				burn_time_left = 0.0
59				burning_ended.emit()
60			_check_death()
61			if is_dead():
62				return
63		if at_wall:
64			attacking_gate.emit(Tuning.SCARECROW_GATE_DPS * delta)
65		else:
66			position.y = minf(position.y + Tuning.SCARECROW_SPEED * delta, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y)
67			at_wall = position.y >= Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y
68	
69	
70	func _check_death() -> void:
71		if is_dead():
72			remove_from_group("enemies")
73			died.emit()
74			queue_free()
75

1	class_name Game
2	extends Node2D
3	## One prototype run: survive SURVIVE_TIME seconds of scarecrows without losing the gate.
4	## Owns the run state (gate HP, elapsed time, kills, win/lose). Restart with R/Enter at the end.
5	
6	signal state_changed(new_state: State)
7	
8	enum State { PLAYING, WON, LOST }
9	
10	const SCARECROW_SCENE := preload("res://game/scarecrow.tscn")
11	const ARCHER_START := Vector2(640, 572)
12	
13	@export var spawning_enabled := true
14	## (start, end) spawn interval used instead of Tuning's when non-zero; only tools/balance_sim.gd sets it.
15	var spawn_interval_override := Vector2.ZERO
16	
17	var state: State = State.PLAYING
18	var gate_hp: float = Tuning.GATE_HP
19	var elapsed := 0.0
20	var kills := 0
21	var spawn_timer := 0.0
22	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
23	
24	@onready var world: Node2D = $World
25	@onready var enemies: Node2D = $World/Enemies
26	@onready var arrows: Node2D = $World/Arrows
27	@onready var archer: Archer = $World/Archer
28	
29	
30	func _ready() -> void:
31		rng.randomize()
32		archer.arrows_parent = arrows
33		reset()
34	
35	
36	func reset() -> void:
37		for child in enemies.get_children() + arrows.get_children():
38			if child.is_in_group("enemies"):
39				child.remove_from_group("enemies")
40			child.queue_free()
41		gate_hp = Tuning.GATE_HP
42		elapsed = 0.0
43		kills = 0
44		spawn_timer = 1.0
45		archer.position = ARCHER_START
46		archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
47		world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
48		_set_state(State.PLAYING)
49	
50	
51	func spawn_scarecrow(at: Vector2) -> Scarecrow:
52		var s := SCARECROW_SCENE.instantiate() as Scarecrow
53		s.position = at
54		s.died.connect(func() -> void: kills += 1)
55		s.attacking_gate.connect(_on_attacking_gate)
56		enemies.add_child(s)
57		return s
58	
59	
60	func spawn_interval() -> float:
61		var t := clampf(elapsed / Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME, 0.0, 1.0)
62		if spawn_interval_override != Vector2.ZERO:
63			return lerpf(spawn_interval_override.x, spawn_interval_override.y, t)
64		return lerpf(Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_START, Tuning.SPAWN_INTERVAL_END, t)
65	
66	
67	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
68		if state != State.PLAYING:
69			return
70		elapsed += delta
71		if elapsed >= Tuning.SURVIVE_TIME:
72			_end(State.WON)
73			return
74		if spawning_enabled:
75			spawn_timer -= delta
76			if spawn_timer <= 0.0:
77				spawn_timer += spawn_interval()
78				spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(rng.randf_range(60.0, Tuning.VIEW.x - 60.0), -40.0))
79	
80	
81	func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
82		if state != State.PLAYING and event.is_action_pressed("restart"):
83			reset()
84	
85	
86	func _on_attacking_gate(amount: float) -> void:
87		if state != State.PLAYING:
88			return
89		gate_hp = maxf(gate_hp - amount, 0.0)
90		if gate_hp <= 0.0:
91			_end(State.LOST)
92	
93	
94	func _end(result: State) -> void:
95		world.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED   # freeze the field; HUD shows the result
96		_set_state(result)
97	
98	
99	func _set_state(s: State) -> void:
100		state = s
101		state_changed.emit(s)
102

2	extends Node2D
3	## A fire arrow: flies straight, hits the first scarecrow within ARROW_HIT_RADIUS, sets it burning.
4	
5	var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
6	var element: StringName = &"fire"
7	
8	
9	func launch(from: Vector2, direction: Vector2) -> void:
10		position = from
11		velocity = direction.normalized() * Tuning.ARROW_SPEED
12		rotation = velocity.angle() + PI / 2.0     # the sprite points up
13	
14	
15	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
16		if is_queued_for_deletion():
17			return
18		position += velocity * delta
19		for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
20			var s := enemy as Scarecrow
21			if s and s.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= Tuning.ARROW_HIT_RADIUS:
22				s.hit(Tuning.ARROW_DAMAGE, element)
23				queue_free()
24				return
25		if position.y < -60.0 or position.x < -60.0 or position.x > Tuning.VIEW.x + 60.0:
26			queue_free()

class_name Arrow
extends Node2D
## A fire arrow: flies straight, hits the first scarecrow within ARROW_HIT_RADIUS, sets it burning.

var velocity := Vector2.ZERO
var element: StringName = &"fire"


func launch(from: Vector2, direction: Vector2) -> void:
	position = from
	velocity = direction.normalized() * Tuning.ARROW_SPEED
	rotation = velocity.angle() + PI / 2.0     # the sprite points up


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	position += velocity * delta
	for enemy in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var s := enemy as Scarecrow
		if s and s.global_position.distance_to(global_position) <= Tuning.ARROW_HIT_RADIUS:
			s.hit(Tuning.ARROW_DAMAGE, element)
			queue_free()
			return
	if position.y < -60.0 or position.x < -60.0 or position.x > Tuning.VIEW.x + 60.0:
		queue_free()

1	# Mimic Keep (walker-mimic-keep-rui-sun)
2	
3	Defend Mimi, the treasure-chest mimic, from the castle wall. The archer slides along the wall
4	and fires on their own; fire arrows set Straw Scarecrows burning before they reach the gate.
5	
6	This repository is the game for CSYE 7270 from Assignment 5 on. It follows the Assignment 4
7	game design document (*Mimic Keep GDD v0.1*). It replaces walker-lamplight-rui-sun, the game of
8	Assignments 2–3: this is the course's one allowed change of game, recorded in FRICTIONAL.md.
9	
10	## Starting point
11	
12	A new, empty Godot 4.7.2 project. No starter code was copied: the walker-jumpman platformer code
13	does not fit a fixed-screen defense game. The test idiom (headless `SceneTree` scripts, real key
14	events, pinned frame rate) follows the earlier walker projects.
15	
16	## Engine and renderer
17	
18	- Godot **4.7.2** stable (`4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`)
19	- Renderer: **Forward+**, Godot's default. The editor leaves `rendering/renderer/rendering_method`
20	  out of `godot/project.godot` because it equals the default; `config/features` lists "Forward Plus".
21	- Viewport 1280×720, stretch mode `canvas_items`; 2D textures use nearest filtering
22	
23	## Run
24	
25	Open `godot/project.godot` in Godot 4.7.2 and press F5, or:
26	
27	```bash
28	godot --path godot
29	```
30	
31	The 3D showcase scene (Shield Goblin's wooden shield, used for the material work) is
32	`res://showcase/shield_room.tscn`; open it and press F6.
33	
34	## Controls
35	
36	| Key | Action |
37	|---|---|
38	| A / D, Left / Right | move the archer along the wall |
39	| (none) | the archer fires on their own at the nearest scarecrow in a 120° upward cone |
40	| Esc / P | pause / resume |
41	| R / Enter | play again after a win or a loss |
42	
43	## The prototype's rules
44	
45	One wave of Straw Scarecrows for 90 s. Every number lives in `godot/game/tuning.gd`, marked as
46	from the GDD or chosen for this prototype.
47	
48	- A fire arrow deals 10 damage and sets the scarecrow **Burning**: 4 damage per second for 4 s of
49	  game time (GDD 6.3). Another fire hit refreshes the burn to a full 4 s; damage does not stack.
50	  Burning follows `Engine.time_scale` and stops while the game is paused.
51	- A scarecrow at the wall takes 5 HP per second from the gate. The gate has 100 HP (GDD 6.2).
52	- Survive 90 s to win; lose when the gate reaches 0.
53	
54	## Tests
55	
56	```bash
57	godot --headless --path godot --import
58	./scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60
59	./scripts/run-test.sh test_input.gd 60
60	./scripts/run-test.sh test_burning_tint.gd 30    # also 60 and 144
61	./scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60
62	./scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60
63	```
64	
65	`scripts/run-test.sh` runs one test headless at a pinned frame rate, writes `logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log`
66	and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR`; run it from the repository root.
67	`test_rules.gd` (23 checks) covers spawning, targeting, the burn's duration, damage, refresh,
68	time scale and pause, gate damage, losing and winning. `test_input.gd` (14 checks) drives the
69	real keys through `Input.parse_input_event`. The Assignment 5 suites and their counts are in
70	TEST-REPORT.md. Every test prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.
71	
72	## Assets
73	
74	One downloaded texture set: Poly Haven's **Wood Planks** (1K PNG, CC0) in
75	`godot/assets/textures/wood_planks/`, for the shield material. Its credits, md5s and the role of
76	each file are in `ATTRIBUTION.md` next to it. The material uses the OpenGL normal map

# Mimic Keep (walker-mimic-keep-rui-sun)

Defend Mimi, the treasure-chest mimic, from the castle wall. The archer slides along the wall
and fires on their own; fire arrows set Straw Scarecrows burning before they reach the gate.

This repository is the game for CSYE 7270 from Assignment 5 on. It follows the Assignment 4
game design document (*Mimic Keep GDD v0.1*). It replaces walker-lamplight-rui-sun, the game of
Assignments 2–3: this is the course's one allowed change of game, recorded in FRICTIONAL.md.

## Starting point

A new, empty Godot 4.7.2 project. No starter code was copied: the walker-jumpman platformer code
does not fit a fixed-screen defense game. The test idiom (headless `SceneTree` scripts, real key
events, pinned frame rate) follows the earlier walker projects.

## Engine and renderer

- Godot **4.7.2** stable (`4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`)
- Renderer: **Forward+**, Godot's default. The editor leaves `rendering/renderer/rendering_method`
  out of `godot/project.godot` because it equals the default; `config/features` lists "Forward Plus".
- Viewport 1280×720, stretch mode `canvas_items`; 2D textures use nearest filtering

## Run

Open `godot/project.godot` in Godot 4.7.2 and press F5, or:

```bash
godot --path godot
```

The 3D showcase scene (Shield Goblin's wooden shield, used for the material work) is
`res://showcase/shield_room.tscn`; open it and press F6.

## Controls

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| A / D, Left / Right | move the archer along the wall |
| (none) | the archer fires on their own at the nearest scarecrow in a 120° upward cone |
| Esc / P | pause / resume |
| R / Enter | play again after a win or a loss |

## The prototype's rules

One wave of Straw Scarecrows for 90 s. Every number lives in `godot/game/tuning.gd`, marked as
from the GDD or chosen for this prototype.

- A fire arrow deals 10 damage and sets the scarecrow **Burning**: 4 damage per second for 4 s of
  game time (GDD 6.3). Another fire hit refreshes the burn to a full 4 s; damage does not stack.
  Burning follows `Engine.time_scale` and stops while the game is paused.
- A scarecrow at the wall takes 5 HP per second from the gate. The gate has 100 HP (GDD 6.2).
- Survive 90 s to win; lose when the gate reaches 0.

## Tests

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --import
./scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60
./scripts/run-test.sh test_input.gd 60
./scripts/run-test.sh test_burning_tint.gd 30    # also 60 and 144
./scripts/run-test.sh test_materials.gd 60
./scripts/run-test.sh normal_map_check.gd 60
```

`scripts/run-test.sh` runs one test headless at a pinned frame rate, writes `logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log`
and exits 1 on `SHADER ERROR` or `SCRIPT ERROR`; run it from the repository root.
`test_rules.gd` (23 checks) covers spawning, targeting, the burn's duration, damage, refresh,
time scale and pause, gate damage, losing and winning. `test_input.gd` (14 checks) drives the
real keys through `Input.parse_input_event`. The Assignment 5 suites and their counts are in
TEST-REPORT.md. Every test prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.

## Assets

One downloaded texture set: Poly Haven's **Wood Planks** (1K PNG, CC0) in
`godot/assets/textures/wood_planks/`, for the shield material. Its credits, md5s and the role of
each file are in `ATTRIBUTION.md` next to it. The material uses the OpenGL normal map
(`_nor_gl`); `_nor_dx` is kept only to calibrate `godot/tests/normal_map_check.gd`.
Nothing is AI-generated. Everything else is written by code in this repository:

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --script res://tools/make_sprites.gd      # 4 sprites
godot --headless --path godot --script res://tools/make_shield_mesh.gd  # shield mesh
godot --headless --path godot --script res://tools/make_scorch_mask.gd  # shield scorch mask
godot --path godot --script res://tools/capture_prototype.gd            # evidence frames (not headless)
godot --path godot --script res://tools/capture_burn_values.gd         # burn_mix 0/0.5/0.65/1/2 captures (not headless)
godot --path godot --script res://tools/capture_in_play.gd             # scripted ignite/kill frames (not headless)
godot --path godot --script res://tools/capture_shield_room.gd -- sweep  # interface sweep, 21 frames (not headless)
godot --path godot --script res://tools/capture_shield_room.gd -- shot <name>  # one shield-room frame
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File godot/tools/os_screenshot.ps1 -Godot <Godot .exe>  # OS screenshot of the burn frame
godot --headless --path godot --script res://tools/compare_os_screenshot.gd  # in-engine vs OS screenshot
```

## What Assignment 5 added

Two hand-written shaders (every line by Rui) and everything around them (by Claude Code and three
agent sessions, reviewed and checked by Rui). Details: CHANGE-BRIEF.md, MATERIALS.md, TEST-REPORT.md.

- **Burning tint** — `godot/shaders/burning_tint.gdshader` (canvas_item). While a scarecrow is Burning,
  its sprite is mixed toward (255, 192, 32) by `burn_mix`, 0.65 at the hit and 0 after 4 s of game time.
  The driver `godot/game/burning_tint.gd` sets it every frame from `burn_time_left` on each scarecrow's
  own material; `godot/tests/test_burning_tint.gd` checks it at 30, 60 and 144 fps.
- **Wooden shield** — `godot/shaders/shield_wood.gdshader` (spatial): Poly Haven albedo with
  `source_color`, roughness, an OpenGL normal map with `hint_normal`, and a code-generated scorch mask;
  seven uniforms in two groups. Two materials, `godot/showcase/shield_new.tres` and `shield_burned.tres`,
  on two shields in `res://showcase/shield_room.tscn`. Audited by `godot/tests/test_materials.gd`
  and `normal_map_check.gd`.
- **Hint experiment** — `godot/shaders/hint_experiment.gdshader` in `res://showcase/hint_experiment.tscn`:
  one grey strip read with and without `source_color` (64/128/192 vs 137/188/225).
- **The language** — `godot/shaders/standard_generated.gdshader` (an unedited StandardMaterial3D
  conversion) and LANGUAGE-NOTES.md.
- Evidence (in-engine captures, logs, mutations) in `evidence/`; the agent prompts in `prompts/` and their
  transcripts in `sessions/`; the record of who did what in FRICTIONAL.md and SOURCES.md.

## Film

*Mimic Keep: The Test Cannot See the Fire* — Brutalist godot-gamedev explainer (walker), 4K, 6:13.

- File: `claude-liam-walker-mimic-keep-a5-gamedev.mp4`
- SHA-256: `10a99c22d53e31b330393846d9a1ecddd5d1f360e6f78dcf417baa45601d0ec3`
- **[▶ Watch the film](https://northeastern-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/g/personal/sun_r3_northeastern_edu/IQDZY7AdKwcTRaacSlGB4bqyAfG3lmOAaQuQDUvm744kg4A?e=hkY4ve)**
  — Northeastern OneDrive, viewable by anyone signed in with a Northeastern account (the MP4 is not
  in this repository)
- Game source shown: commit `879324b`. Beat sheet, script, captures' driver and evidence ledger:
  `youtube/claude-liam-walker-mimic-keep-a5-gamedev/`.

## Known limitations

- Two gameplay faults found in Rui's playtest are still in this revision, because Assignment 5 may
  not change game rules: long sideways shots aim at where a scarecrow was and can miss, and a
  scarecrow attacking the wall stands level with the archer, outside the fire cone, so it cannot be
  shot. The wall fix is on branch `gameplay-fixes` (commit `dbb4806`), to be merged after `a5`.
- The tint was checked by Rui in play and in captures; nobody else has playtested it.
- One enemy type and one wave. No gold, XP, level-ups, Mimi's moods or shop, other elements, or
  bosses from the GDD.
- Placeholder art: flat code-drawn sprites, not final art.
- Balance: the spawn rate was eased after Rui's first playtest (see FRICTIONAL.md);
  `godot --headless --path godot --script res://tools/balance_sim.gd --fixed-fps 60 -- 3.0 1.5`
  compares tunings with two stand-in players.
- Level-ups, upgrade cards and other GDD systems are planned for after Assignment 5, so that
  Assignment 5 changes only presentation, not game rules.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/check-session.sh <session.jsonl>
# The two checks after every agent session: the final result event (did it stop at --max-turns?
# any permission denials?) and that godot/shaders/ and scripts/run-test.sh are untouched.
f="$1"
echo "== final result event in $f"
python -c '
import json, sys
res = None
for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    try:
        e = json.loads(line)
    except ValueError:
        continue
    if e.get("type") == "result":
        res = e
if res is None:
    print("NO result event: the session did not finish cleanly"); sys.exit(1)
for k in ("subtype", "is_error", "num_turns", "duration_ms", "total_cost_usd"):
    print(f"{k}: {res.get(k)}")
d = res.get("permission_denials") or []
print(f"permission_denials: {len(d)}")
for x in d:
    print("  -", x.get("tool_name"), json.dumps(x.get("tool_input"))[:160])
' "$f"
echo "== git diff --stat godot/shaders/ (must print nothing)"
git diff --stat HEAD -- godot/shaders/
git status --short -- godot/shaders/
echo "== git diff --stat scripts/run-test.sh (must print nothing)"
git diff --stat HEAD -- scripts/run-test.sh

2	## Regression test for Rui's playtest 2026-10-29: scarecrows attacking the wall could not be shot.

6	
7	const MIN_REACH := 60.0                 # px either side of the archer; 530 gives ~73
8	
9	var failures := 0
10	var passes := 0
11	
12	
13	func _initialize() -> void:
14		_run.call_deferred()
15	
16	
17	func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
18		if ok:
19			passes += 1
20			print("PASS  ", name)
21		else:
22			failures += 1
23			print("FAIL  ", name, "  ", detail)
24	
25	
26	func _run() -> void:
27		var game := (load("res://game/main.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate() as Game
28		game.spawning_enabled = false
29		root.add_child(game)
30		await process_frame
31		var archer := game.archer
32		var reach := (archer.global_position.y - Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y) * tan(deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0))
33	
34		_check("the wall stop line is above the archer", Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y < archer.global_position.y,
35			"stop_y=%.0f archer_y=%.0f" % [Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y, archer.global_position.y])
36		_check("a scarecrow at the wall is in the cone at least %.0f px either side" % MIN_REACH, reach >= MIN_REACH,
37			"reach=%.1f px" % reach)
38	
39		# Targeting at the wall, both sides; the cone still applies beyond the reach.
40		for dx in [0.0, -30.0, 30.0, -MIN_REACH, MIN_REACH, reach + 20.0]:
41			var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(archer.global_position.x + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
42			await physics_frame
43			var expect := absf(dx) <= MIN_REACH
44			_check("a scarecrow at the wall %+.0f px from the archer is %s" % [dx, "targeted" if expect else "ignored"],
45				(archer.nearest_target() == s) == expect, "at_wall=%s" % str(s.at_wall))
46			s.remove_from_group("enemies")
47			s.free()
48	
49		# A real auto-fired arrow hits a scarecrow that is already attacking the wall.
50		var gate_before := game.gate_hp
51		var target := game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(archer.global_position.x + MIN_REACH, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
52		archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
53		for i in 60:                                           # one second at 60 ticks
54			await physics_frame
55		_check("an auto-fired arrow hits a scarecrow at the wall", not is_instance_valid(target) or target.hp < Tuning.SCARECROW_HP,
56			"hp=%s" % (str(target.hp) if is_instance_valid(target) else "dead"))
57		_check("that scarecrow was attacking the gate", game.gate_hp < gate_before, "gate=%.2f" % game.gate_hp)
58	
59		print("%d passed, %d failed" % [passes, failures])
60		quit(1 if failures > 0 else 0)

		failures += 1
		print("FAIL  ", name, "  ", detail)


func _run() -> void:
	var game := (load("res://game/main.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame
	var archer := game.archer
	var reach := (archer.global_position.y - Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y) * tan(deg_to_rad(Tuning.FIRE_CONE_DEG / 2.0))

	_check("the wall stop line is above the archer", Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y < archer.global_position.y,
		"stop_y=%.0f archer_y=%.0f" % [Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y, archer.global_position.y])
	_check("a scarecrow at the wall is in the cone at least %.0f px either side" % MIN_REACH, reach >= MIN_REACH,
		"reach=%.1f px" % reach)

	# Targeting at the wall, both sides; the cone still applies beyond the reach.
	for dx in [0.0, -30.0, 30.0, -MIN_REACH, MIN_REACH, reach + 20.0]:
		var s := game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(archer.global_position.x + dx, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
		await physics_frame
		var expect := absf(dx) <= MIN_REACH
		_check("a scarecrow at the wall %+.0f px from the archer is %s" % [dx, "targeted" if expect else "ignored"],
			(archer.nearest_target() == s) == expect, "at_wall=%s" % str(s.at_wall))
		s.remove_from_group("enemies")
		s.free()

	# A real auto-fired arrow hits a scarecrow that is already attacking the wall.
	var gate_before := game.gate_hp
	var target := game.spawn_scarecrow(Vector2(archer.global_position.x + MIN_REACH, Tuning.SCARECROW_STOP_Y))
	archer.fire_cooldown = 0.0
	for i in 60:                                           # one second at 60 ticks
		await physics_frame
	_check("an auto-fired arrow hits a scarecrow at the wall", not is_instance_valid(target) or target.hp < Tuning.SCARECROW_HP,
		"hp=%s" % (str(target.hp) if is_instance_valid(target) else "dead"))
	_check("that scarecrow was attacking the gate", game.gate_hp < gate_before, "gate=%.2f" % game.gate_hp)

	print("%d passed, %d failed" % [passes, failures])
	quit(1 if failures > 0 else 0)

extends SceneTree
## Game-rule checks for the Mimic Keep prototype, run through the real main scene and game loop.
##   godot --headless --path godot --script res://tests/test_rules.gd --fixed-fps 60
## Prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on any failure.

const MAIN := preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const TICK := 1.0 / 60.0          # physics ticks per second is the project default, 60

var passed := 0
var failed := 0
var game: Game


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()


func _run() -> void:
	game = MAIN.instantiate() as Game
	game.spawning_enabled = false
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame

	await _test_spawning()
	await _test_holds_fire_without_target()
	await _test_fire_arrow_ignites_and_kills()
	await _test_burn_duration_and_damage()
	await _test_burn_retrigger_refreshes()
	await _test_burn_under_time_scale()
	await _test_burn_frozen_while_paused()
	await _test_gate_damage_and_loss()
	await _test_survive_to_win()

	print("test_rules: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)


# --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------

func _check(name: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	if ok:
		passed += 1
		print("PASS %s" % name)
	else:
		failed += 1
		print("FAIL %s  %s" % [name, detail])


func _ticks(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame


func _seconds(s: float) -> void:
	await _ticks(roundi(s / TICK))


## Clean field, archer on or off, spawning off.
func _fresh(archer_on: bool) -> void:
	game.spawning_enabled = false

# Assignment 6 — Particle effects

## 2026-11-05 — Before the brief: the wall fix merged, the new wrapper, the baseline

The wall-targeting fix from Rui's 2026-10-29 playtest (`SCARECROW_STOP_Y` 570 → 530, new
`test_wall_targeting.gd`) had been kept off main because Assignment 5 forbade gameplay changes. A6
forbids them too, so it had to land before the A6 baseline or wait until after A6. Rui chose "先合并吧".
Claude merged `gameplay-fixes` with a merge commit (`48886bb`), so the history shows it arrived after
the `a5` tag, which still points at `f71d358`. There were no conflicts; every suite passed on the merge.

Claude then replaced `scripts/run-test.sh` with the assignment's wrapper, verbatim, in its own commit
(`ddaaa53`), and took the baseline through it after `--import` (`056bcc0`, copies in
`evidence/a6-baseline/`): test_rules 23/0, test_input 14/0, test_materials 132/0, normal_map_check
9/0 at 60 fps; test_burning_tint 49/0 and test_wall_targeting 10/0 at 30, 60 and 144 fps. No log
contains SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR. `check-session.sh` already diffs `godot/shaders/` and
`run-test.sh` against HEAD, so it needed no change.

Effect B: Claude listed four candidates (burning embers, gate smoke, meadow ambience, fire-arrow
trail) with what each would show and where it would be hard. Rui chose burning embers.

## 2026-11-05 — CHANGE-BRIEF: Rui's specification, Claude's review

**Rui** wrote CHANGE-BRIEF.md: both jobs, the `hit_taken` boundary exception, both intent blocks, the
settings for all four emitters, rules A1–A4 and B1–B7, boundaries, evidence split, both frame strips,
nine predicted failures, the price predictions and budgets, and the six answers. Rui's text as saved is
commit `b1d2e08`. The first "改完了" found the file unchanged on disk; Rui had not saved it yet.

**What Claude checked.** Every file and line reference in the brief was correct (`scarecrow.gd:8/9/16/
33-39/42-46`, `arrow.gd:22`, `main.gd:95`). Claude probed Godot 4.7.2 headless for the facts the
settings depend on:
- CPUParticles2D has no `amount_ratio` and no turbulence; GPUParticles2D has `amount_ratio`,
  `use_fixed_seed`, `seed` and `finished`. The brief's node choice holds.
- `ParticleProcessMaterial.initial_velocity` and `scale` still exist in 4.7.2, as editor-only `Vector2`
  range properties that are not stored. Setting a float to them is ignored silently and min/max stay
  0, which is what the brief's Failure 1 predicts. To be confirmed by the Step 2 mutation.
- A `Curve` defaults to the range 0–1 and stores 1.2 as 1.0 without a warning. The brief's scale
  curves peaked at 1.20 and 1.40.
- `direction` defaults to (1, 0, 0), to the right, and `particle_flag_disable_z` to false. The brief
  described "upward" emitters but did not set either.

Claude also computed what the settings would produce: A2's spread of 150° would throw straw about
95 px to each side, over three times the scarecrow's 56 px width the intent allowed; Effect B's first
frame could hold at most one ember (explosiveness 0, 20 embers per second), not the "full density" the
strip predicted; and arrows' different flight times let three A bursts overlap, not two. The reset in
`main.gd:37-40` never clears a new `World/Effects` node, and no rule freed finished bursts. Claude
measured the scarecrow's head at 23–25 px wide, so the flash's 21 px peak stays smaller than the head.

**How the corrections went in.** Rui chose the Assignment 5 way ("按 A5 的办法"): the original stays at
`b1d2e08`, the file is corrected in place before the first prompt, and the Revision Log lists the
changes. Claude converted the file to Markdown and applied the factual corrections; a word-by-word
comparison with `b1d2e08` showed no other wording changes. Claude proposed values for six items;
Rui approved all six ("1–6 都同意"): curve points with `Curve.max_value = 1.5`, A2's colour-ramp stops,
texture paths and sizes, A2 spread 150° → 40°, A2 angle 0–360, and the `World/Effects` node with a
new Rule A5 (cleanup and reset).

**What Rui wrote after the review:** the phase durations in both intent blocks, the emission
rates, the Effect B frame 10 and 20 predictions, Rule A3 and answer 3 for three overlapping bursts
(66 particles), Failure 2, the Effect B peak (ten effect sets, about 260 particles), new budgets
(A 0.25 ms, B 0.60 ms, combined 0.85 ms GPU time), answer 4 (a headless run reports CPU time close to
the empty-scene control), and the Revision Log entry dated 2026-11-05 without "(review)". Claude did not write these.

Still a prediction, to be measured: whether a GPUParticles2D keeps its live particles when it is
reparented to `World/Effects` on death (Rule B4), and whether a hidden GPU emitter keeps simulating
(Rule B6).

`scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (scripts/run-test.sh:2) runs
`godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout`


  10/0 at 30/60/144. Each test prints one PASS/FAIL line per check and exits 1 on failure
  (godot/tests/test_rules.gd:2-4, 34-35). test_input and test_burning_tint send real keys through
  `Input.parse_input_event` (godot/tests/test_input.gd:2, 51; test_burning_tint.gd:4-5, 150).

- Headless uses `DisplayServer` "headless", a dummy renderer that draws nothing: no headless test
  can judge how a particle looks or moves (CLAUDE.md A5 probe; CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6).

  `seed`, `finished`; CPUParticles2D has no `amount_ratio` and no turbulence. A `Curve` defaults to
  0–1 and silently clamps 1.2 to 1.0. `direction` defaults to (1, 0, 0); `particle_flag_disable_z`
  defaults to false.

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by the human (Rui) and are never edited by an agent —
not created, modified, renamed, reformatted or deleted. If a shader looks wrong, report it and stop.
`scripts/check-session.sh` verifies after each session that `godot/shaders/` and
`scripts/run-test.sh` are unchanged (scripts/check-session.sh:29-33).

Effect settings (every value in CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3) live in scene files in `godot/effects/`
(`.tscn`, with their ParticleProcessMaterial / CanvasItemMaterial sub-resources), not in code.
Driver scripts only toggle `emitting`, set `amount_ratio`, reparent and free.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4.7.2 names only. Godot 3 → Godot 4: `Particles2D` → **GPUParticles2D**,
`ParticlesMaterial` → **ParticleProcessMaterial**, `GradientTexture` → **GradientTexture1D**,
`flag_disable_z` → **`particle_flag_disable_z`**, single `initial_velocity` / `scale` / `damping` /
`angle` → **`_min` / `_max` pairs**. In 4.7.2 `initial_velocity` and `scale` still exist as editor-only
Vector2 ranges that are not stored; assigning a float is silently ignored (FRICTIONAL.md:556-558).
- Node: `amount`, `amount_ratio`, `emitting`, `one_shot`, `explosiveness`, `lifetime`, `preprocess`,
  `local_coords`, `visibility_rect`, `texture`, `process_material`, `material`, signal `finished`.
- ParticleProcessMaterial: `emission_shape` (`EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE` / `_BOX`), `emission_sphere_radius`,
  `emission_box_extents`, `direction`, `spread`, `gravity` (Vector3), `initial_velocity_min/max`,
  `damping_min/max`, `scale_min/max`, `angle_min/max`, `color_ramp`, `scale_curve` (a CurveTexture),
  `turbulence_enabled`, `turbulence_influence_min/max`, `particle_flag_disable_z`.
- Blend: `CanvasItemMaterial.blend_mode` = `BLEND_MODE_ADD` / `BLEND_MODE_MIX`.
- Only `amount_ratio`, `finished`, the `initial_velocity`/`scale` behaviour, the Curve range and the
  two defaults above were probed. The rest are the documented 4.x API, not probed here: before relying
  on one, read it back with `get()` / `get_property_list()` in a headless script and report, don't guess.

## Out of scope

- Game rules of any kind: HP, damage, burn length or DPS, the burn timer, movement, targeting, fire
  rate, arrow flight and hit detection, gate damage, spawning, win/loss, pause, restart, input map.
  Effect code may read `burn_time_left`, `is_burning()` and the signals; it never writes game state.
- In `scarecrow.gd`, anything beyond the one `hit_taken` signal and its one emit; reordering damage,
  `ignite()` or `_check_death()`. In `main.tscn`, anything beyond the one `World/Effects` node.
- Editing `tuning.gd`, `main.gd`, `archer.gd`, `arrow.gd`, any existing test, `scripts/run-test.sh`,
  `godot/project.godot`, or loosening an existing test expectation.
- Changing `amount` at runtime instead of `amount_ratio`; reusing one one-shot burst node; parenting a
  burst to the scarecrow; CPUParticles2D for either effect.
- The Assignment 5 work: the burning tint, its material and driver, the shield room, hint experiment,
  and every existing sprite and texture. Particles on any object other than the scarecrow / its hits.
- GDD systems not in this change (gold, XP, level-ups, shop, other elements, bosses) (README.md:133-134).

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists, so this file has no `@AGENTS.md` line.
- Whether a GPUParticles2D emits `finished` in a headless run, where no particle process runs
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6). Rule A5 cleanup frees on `finished`; a headless test may need another check.
- Whether a GPUParticles2D keeps its live particles when reparented on death (Rule B4), and whether
  a hidden one keeps simulating (Rule B6) — still predictions (FRICTIONAL.md:585-587).
- The brief gives no frame rates for the new effect tests; §7 strips are captured at 30 fps.
- The names of the burst scene, the B emitter scene and their driver scripts are not in the brief.
- `Curve.max_value` is the brief's name for the range; not read back in 4.7.2 yet.
- Rui's shaders: `burning_tint.gdshader` (6a2c298), `shield_wood.gdshader` (416e5f5, 822d27a),
  `hint_experiment.gdshader` (f76bb03).

  godot/game/arrow.gd:22 when an arrow is within `ARROW_HIT_RADIUS` 26 px (godot/game/tuning.gd:15).

  `global_position` between scarecrow.gd:38 (`ignite()`) and :39 (`_check_death()`) (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5).

  already burning (lines 42-46): a refresh emits nothing. Counted down in `_physics_process`; at
  ≤ `BURN_END_EPSILON` (line 13) set to 0 and `burning_ended` emitted (lines 49-59). Death while
  burning emits `died`, never `burning_ended` (lines 60, 70-74).
- `BURN_DURATION := 4.0`, `BURN_DPS := 4.0` (godot/game/tuning.gd:26-27).
- Appears in: every scarecrow. `godot/game/scarecrow.tscn` = root `Scarecrow` (Node2D) + child `Sprite`
  (Sprite2D, local-to-scene ShaderMaterial on Rui's `burning_tint.gdshader`, driver `burning_tint.gd`)
  (scarecrow.tscn:8-18); instanced by `Game.spawn_scarecrow()` into `World/Enemies` (main.gd:10, 51-57).

  INHERIT (main.gd:47).

`scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (scripts/run-test.sh:2) runs
`godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout`
(default 120 s), tees to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`, and exits 1 on a non-zero exit or a log line with
`SHADER ERROR` / `SCRIPT ERROR` (lines 3-14). **Realtime mode:** `realtime` as the second argument
drops `--fixed-fps` and logs to `logs/<name>_realtime.log` (lines 5-6, 10); it is still headless (line 11).

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --import          # after a fresh clone or a deleted godot/.godot (README.md:57)
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60        # also test_input, test_materials, normal_map_check at 60
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_burning_tint.gd 30 # and 60, 144; test_wall_targeting.gd the same
bash scripts/run-test.sh <test>.gd realtime 180  # realtime mode, 180 s timeout
```

  test_materials 132/0, normal_map_check 9/0 at 60; test_burning_tint 49/0, test_wall_targeting 10/0
  at 30/60/144. One PASS/FAIL line per check, exit 1 on failure (godot/tests/test_rules.gd:2-4, 34-35).
  Real keys go through `Input.parse_input_event` (godot/tests/test_input.gd:2, 51).

  feedback test may set `burn_time_left` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6).

  or moves (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6). Physics runs at 60 ticks/s whatever `--fixed-fps` says.

  `damping_min/max`, `scale_min/max`, `angle_min/max`, `color_ramp`, `scale_curve` (CurveTexture),
  `turbulence_enabled`, `turbulence_influence_min/max`, `particle_flag_disable_z`.

# CLAUDE.md — Mimic Keep

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2 stable, `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf` (README.md:18);
  `config/features` lists `"4.7"` and `"Forward Plus"` (godot/project.godot:16).
- **Renderer:** Forward+, the default, so `rendering_method` is absent from godot/project.godot
  (README.md:19-20). No HDR 2D key; 2D filter nearest (godot/project.godot:51-53).
- **Viewport:** 1280×720, stretch `canvas_items` (godot/project.godot:20-22). Main scene
  `res://game/main.tscn` (godot/project.godot:15).

### Effect A — Arrow Impact Burst: two GPUParticles2D, flash A1 + straw A2 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3)
- Event owner: `Scarecrow.hit(damage, element)` (godot/game/scarecrow.gd:33-39), called only from
  godot/game/arrow.gd:22 when an arrow is within `ARROW_HIT_RADIUS` 26 px (godot/game/tuning.gd:15).
- `signal hit_taken(position: Vector2)` **does not exist yet**; the brief allows adding it and emitting
  `global_position` between scarecrow.gd:38 (`ignite()`) and :39 (`_check_death()`) (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5).
- A lethal hit: `_check_death()` removes the group, emits `died`, `queue_free()`s (scarecrow.gd:70-74).
- Appears in: one new burst scene per hit under a new Node2D `World/Effects` after `World/Archer`
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5). Today `World` holds `Enemies`, `Arrows`, `Archer` (godot/game/main.tscn:19-26);
  `reset()` frees only Enemies and Arrows children (godot/game/main.gd:36-40). Fire interval 0.6 s
  (tuning.gd:10).

### Effect B — Burning Embers: two GPUParticles2D, embers B1 + smoke B2 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3)
- Condition owner: `godot/game/scarecrow.gd` (class `Scarecrow`, line 1). Signals `burning_started`,
  `burning_ended`, `died` (lines 8-10); `var burn_time_left: float` (line 16); `is_burning()` is
  `burn_time_left > 0.0` (lines 25-26).
- `ignite()` sets `burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION` and emits `burning_started` only when not
  already burning (lines 42-46): a refresh emits nothing. Counted down in `_physics_process`; at
  ≤ `BURN_END_EPSILON` (line 13) set to 0 and `burning_ended` emitted (lines 49-59). Death while
  burning emits `died`, never `burning_ended` (lines 60, 70-74).
- `BURN_DURATION := 4.0`, `BURN_DPS := 4.0` (godot/game/tuning.gd:26-27).
- Appears in: every scarecrow. `godot/game/scarecrow.tscn` = root `Scarecrow` (Node2D) + child `Sprite`
  (Sprite2D, local-to-scene ShaderMaterial on Rui's `burning_tint.gdshader`, driver `burning_tint.gd`)
  (scarecrow.tscn:8-18); instanced by `Game.spawn_scarecrow()` into `World/Enemies` (main.gd:10, 51-57).
- Game end: `_end()` sets `World.process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED` (main.gd:95); `reset()` restores
  INHERIT (main.gd:47).
- Not yet present, named by the brief: `godot/effects/`, `godot/effects/textures/{soft_dot,straw_chip,
  smoke_dot}.png`, written by `godot/tools/make_particle_textures.gd` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3).

### Tests — always through scripts/run-test.sh, from the repository root
`scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (scripts/run-test.sh:2) runs
`godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout`
(default 120 s), tees to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`, and exits 1 on a non-zero exit or a log line with
`SHADER ERROR` / `SCRIPT ERROR` (lines 3-14). **Realtime mode:** `realtime` as the second argument
drops `--fixed-fps` and logs to `logs/<name>_realtime.log` (lines 5-6, 10); it is still headless (line 11).

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --import          # after a fresh clone or a deleted godot/.godot (README.md:57)
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60        # also test_input, test_materials, normal_map_check at 60
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_burning_tint.gd 30 # and 60, 144; test_wall_targeting.gd the same
bash scripts/run-test.sh <test>.gd realtime 180  # realtime mode, 180 s timeout
```
- A6 baseline (commit 056bcc0, evidence/a6-baseline/): test_rules 23/0, test_input 14/0,
  test_materials 132/0, normal_map_check 9/0 at 60; test_burning_tint 49/0, test_wall_targeting 10/0
  at 30/60/144. One PASS/FAIL line per check, exit 1 on failure (godot/tests/test_rules.gd:2-4, 34-35).
  Real keys go through `Input.parse_input_event` (godot/tests/test_input.gd:2, 51).
- State tests drive real arrows and keys, never `hit()`, `ignite()` or an effect trigger directly; a
  feedback test may set `burn_time_left` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6).

### Headless facts (probed on this machine, Godot 4.7.2)
- Headless is a dummy renderer that draws nothing: no headless test can judge how a particle looks
  or moves (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6). Physics runs at 60 ticks/s whatever `--fixed-fps` says.
- Probed 2026-11-05 (FRICTIONAL.md:554-561): GPUParticles2D has `amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`,
  `seed`, `finished`; CPUParticles2D has no `amount_ratio` and no turbulence. A `Curve` defaults to
  0–1 and silently stores 1.2 as 1.0. `direction` defaults to (1, 0, 0), `particle_flag_disable_z` to false.
- `godot` on PATH is a shim in `~/bin` (outside the repo) to the portable 4.7.2 console build.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by the human (Rui) and are never edited by an agent —
not created, modified, renamed, reformatted or deleted. If a shader looks wrong, report it and stop.
`scripts/check-session.sh` verifies after each session that `godot/shaders/` and
`scripts/run-test.sh` are unchanged (scripts/check-session.sh:29-33).

Effect settings (every value in CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3) live in scene files in `godot/effects/`, with
their ParticleProcessMaterial and CanvasItemMaterial as sub-resources, not in code. Driver scripts
only toggle `emitting`, set `amount_ratio`, reparent and free.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4.7.2 names, never Godot 3 ones: `Particles2D` → **GPUParticles2D**, `ParticlesMaterial` →
**ParticleProcessMaterial**, `GradientTexture` → **GradientTexture1D**, `flag_disable_z` →
**`particle_flag_disable_z`**, a single `initial_velocity` / `scale` / `damping` / `angle` → **`_min`/`_max`**.
In 4.7.2 `initial_velocity` and `scale` still exist as editor-only Vector2 ranges that are not stored;
a float assigned to them is silently ignored (FRICTIONAL.md:556-558).
- Node: `amount`, `amount_ratio`, `emitting`, `one_shot`, `explosiveness`, `lifetime`, `preprocess`,
  `local_coords`, `visibility_rect`, `texture`, `process_material`, `material`; signal `finished`.
- ParticleProcessMaterial: `emission_shape` (`EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE`/`_BOX`), `emission_sphere_radius`,
  `emission_box_extents`, `direction`, `spread`, `gravity` (Vector3), `initial_velocity_min/max`,
  `damping_min/max`, `scale_min/max`, `angle_min/max`, `color_ramp`, `scale_curve` (CurveTexture),
  `turbulence_enabled`, `turbulence_influence_min/max`, `particle_flag_disable_z`.
- Blend: `CanvasItemMaterial.blend_mode` = `BLEND_MODE_ADD` / `BLEND_MODE_MIX`.
- Probed here: only the facts cited above. The rest is the documented 4.x API, unverified on 4.7.2:
  read a property back with `get_property_list()` in a headless script before relying on it, and if
  it is missing, report it instead of guessing a replacement.

## Out of scope

- Game rules: HP, damage, burn length or DPS, the burn timer, movement, targeting, fire rate, arrow
  flight and hit detection, gate damage, spawning, win/loss, pause, restart, the input map. Effect
  code reads `burn_time_left`, `is_burning()` and signals; it never writes game state.
- In `scarecrow.gd`, anything beyond one `hit_taken` signal and its one emit, or reordering damage,
  `ignite()` and `_check_death()`. In `main.tscn`, anything beyond the one `World/Effects` node.
- Editing `tuning.gd`, `main.gd`, `archer.gd`, `arrow.gd`, `project.godot`, any existing test or
  `scripts/run-test.sh`; loosening an existing test expectation.
- Changing `amount` at runtime instead of `amount_ratio`; reusing one one-shot burst node; parenting a
  burst to the scarecrow; CPUParticles2D for either effect.
- The Assignment 5 work (burning tint, shield room, hint experiment) and every existing sprite and
  texture. Particles on anything but the scarecrow and its hits.
- GDD systems not in this change (gold, XP, level-ups, shop, other elements, bosses) (README.md:133-134).

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists, so this file has no `@AGENTS.md` line.
- Whether a GPUParticles2D emits `finished` headlessly, where no particle process runs
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6); Rule A5 frees bursts on `finished`.
- Whether live particles survive reparenting on death (Rule B4) and whether a hidden emitter keeps
  simulating (Rule B6): still predictions (FRICTIONAL.md:585-587).
- The brief sets no frame rates for the new effect tests; its §7 strips are captured at 30 fps.
- Names of the burst scene, the B emitter scene and their driver scripts are not in the brief.
- `Curve.max_value` is the brief's name for the range; not yet read back on 4.7.2.

# CLAUDE.md — Mimic Keep

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2 stable, `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf` (README.md:18);
  `config/features` lists `"4.7"` and `"Forward Plus"` (godot/project.godot:16).
- **Renderer:** Forward+, the default, so `rendering_method` is absent from godot/project.godot
  (README.md:19-20). No HDR 2D key (godot/project.godot:51-53). 1280×720, stretch `canvas_items`
  (:20-22). Main scene `res://game/main.tscn` (:15).

### Effect A — Arrow Impact Burst: two GPUParticles2D, flash A1 + straw A2 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3)
- Event owner: `Scarecrow.hit(damage, element)` (godot/game/scarecrow.gd:33-39), called only from
  godot/game/arrow.gd:22 when an arrow is within `ARROW_HIT_RADIUS` 26 px (godot/game/tuning.gd:15).
- `signal hit_taken(position: Vector2)` **does not exist yet**; the brief allows adding it and emitting
  `global_position` between scarecrow.gd:38 (`ignite()`) and :39 (`_check_death()`) (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5).
- A lethal hit: `_check_death()` removes the group, emits `died`, `queue_free()`s (scarecrow.gd:70-74).
- Appears in: one new burst scene per hit under a new Node2D `World/Effects` after `World/Archer`
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5). Today `World` holds `Enemies`, `Arrows`, `Archer` (godot/game/main.tscn:19-26);
  `reset()` frees only Enemies and Arrows children (godot/game/main.gd:36-40). Fire interval 0.6 s
  (tuning.gd:10).

### Effect B — Burning Embers: two GPUParticles2D, embers B1 + smoke B2 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3)
- Condition owner: `godot/game/scarecrow.gd` (class `Scarecrow`, line 1). Signals `burning_started`,
  `burning_ended`, `died` (lines 8-10); `var burn_time_left: float` (line 16); `is_burning()` is
  `burn_time_left > 0.0` (lines 25-26).
- `ignite()` sets `burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION` and emits `burning_started` only when not
  already burning (lines 42-46): a refresh emits nothing. Counted down in `_physics_process`; at
  ≤ `BURN_END_EPSILON` (line 13) set to 0 and `burning_ended` emitted (lines 49-59). Death while
  burning emits `died`, never `burning_ended` (lines 60, 70-74).
- `BURN_DURATION := 4.0`, `BURN_DPS := 4.0` (godot/game/tuning.gd:26-27).
- Appears in: every scarecrow. `godot/game/scarecrow.tscn` = root `Scarecrow` (Node2D) + child `Sprite`
  (Sprite2D, local-to-scene ShaderMaterial on Rui's `burning_tint.gdshader`, driver `burning_tint.gd`)
  (scarecrow.tscn:8-18); instanced by `Game.spawn_scarecrow()` into `World/Enemies` (main.gd:10, 51-57).
  Game end sets `World.process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED` (main.gd:95); `reset()` restores it (:47).
- Not present yet: `godot/effects/`, its `textures/*.png` and `godot/tools/make_particle_textures.gd` (brief §3).

### Tests — always through scripts/run-test.sh, from the repository root
`scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (scripts/run-test.sh:2) runs
`godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout`
(default 120 s), tees to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`, and exits 1 on a non-zero exit or a log line with
`SHADER ERROR` / `SCRIPT ERROR` (lines 3-14). **Realtime mode:** `realtime` as the second argument
drops `--fixed-fps` and logs to `logs/<name>_realtime.log` (lines 5-6, 10); it is still headless (line 11).

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --import          # after a fresh clone or a deleted godot/.godot (README.md:57)
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60        # also test_input, test_materials, normal_map_check at 60
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_burning_tint.gd 30 # and 60, 144; test_wall_targeting.gd the same
bash scripts/run-test.sh <test>.gd realtime 180  # realtime mode, 180 s timeout
```
- A6 baseline (commit 056bcc0, evidence/a6-baseline/): test_rules 23/0, test_input 14/0,
  test_materials 132/0, normal_map_check 9/0 at 60; test_burning_tint 49/0, test_wall_targeting 10/0
  at 30/60/144. One PASS/FAIL line per check, exit 1 on failure (godot/tests/test_rules.gd:2-4, 34-35).
  Real keys go through `Input.parse_input_event` (godot/tests/test_input.gd:2, 51).
- State tests drive real arrows and keys, never `hit()`, `ignite()` or an effect trigger directly; a
  feedback test may set `burn_time_left` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6).

### Headless facts (probed on this machine, Godot 4.7.2)
- Headless is a dummy renderer that draws nothing: no headless test can judge how a particle looks
  or moves (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6). Physics runs at 60 ticks/s whatever `--fixed-fps` says.
- Probed 2026-11-05 (FRICTIONAL.md:554-561): GPUParticles2D has `amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`,
  `seed`, `finished`; CPUParticles2D has no `amount_ratio` and no turbulence. A `Curve` defaults to
  0–1 and silently stores 1.2 as 1.0. `direction` defaults to (1, 0, 0), `particle_flag_disable_z` to false.
- `godot` on PATH is a shim in `~/bin` (outside the repo) to the portable 4.7.2 console build.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by the human (Rui) and are never edited by an agent —
not created, modified, renamed, reformatted or deleted. If a shader looks wrong, report it and stop.
`scripts/check-session.sh` verifies after each session that `godot/shaders/` and
`scripts/run-test.sh` are unchanged (scripts/check-session.sh:29-33).

Effect settings (every value in CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3) live in scene files in `godot/effects/`, with
their ParticleProcessMaterial and CanvasItemMaterial as sub-resources, not in code. Driver scripts
only toggle `emitting`, set `amount_ratio`, reparent and free.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4.7.2 names, never Godot 3 ones: `Particles2D` → **GPUParticles2D**, `ParticlesMaterial` →
**ParticleProcessMaterial**, `GradientTexture` → **GradientTexture1D**, `flag_disable_z` →
**`particle_flag_disable_z`**, a single `initial_velocity` / `scale` / `damping` / `angle` → **`_min`/`_max`**.
In 4.7.2 `initial_velocity` and `scale` still exist as editor-only Vector2 ranges that are not stored;
a float assigned to them is silently ignored (FRICTIONAL.md:556-558).
- Node: `amount`, `amount_ratio`, `emitting`, `one_shot`, `explosiveness`, `lifetime`, `preprocess`,
  `local_coords`, `visibility_rect`, `texture`, `process_material`, `material`; signal `finished`.
- ParticleProcessMaterial: `emission_shape` (`EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE`/`_BOX`), `emission_sphere_radius`,
  `emission_box_extents`, `direction`, `spread`, `gravity` (Vector3), `initial_velocity_min/max`,
  `damping_min/max`, `scale_min/max`, `angle_min/max`, `color_ramp`, `scale_curve` (CurveTexture),
  `turbulence_enabled`, `turbulence_influence_min/max`, `particle_flag_disable_z`.
- Blend: `CanvasItemMaterial.blend_mode` = `BLEND_MODE_ADD` / `BLEND_MODE_MIX`.
- Probed here: only the facts cited above. The rest is the documented 4.x API, unverified on 4.7.2:
  read a property back with `get_property_list()` in a headless script before relying on it, and if
  it is missing, report it instead of guessing a replacement.

## Out of scope

- Game rules: HP, damage, burn length or DPS, the burn timer, movement, targeting, fire rate, arrow
  flight and hit detection, gate damage, spawning, win/loss, pause, restart, the input map. Effect
  code reads `burn_time_left`, `is_burning()` and signals; it never writes game state.
- In `scarecrow.gd`, anything beyond one `hit_taken` signal and its one emit, or reordering damage,
  `ignite()` and `_check_death()`. In `main.tscn`, anything beyond the one `World/Effects` node.
- Editing `tuning.gd`, `main.gd`, `archer.gd`, `arrow.gd`, `project.godot`, any existing test or
  `scripts/run-test.sh`; loosening an existing test expectation.
- Changing `amount` at runtime instead of `amount_ratio`; reusing one one-shot burst node; parenting a
  burst to the scarecrow; CPUParticles2D for either effect.
- The Assignment 5 work (burning tint, shield room, hint experiment) and every existing sprite and
  texture. Particles on anything but the scarecrow and its hits.
- GDD systems not in this change (gold, XP, level-ups, shop, other elements, bosses) (README.md:133-134).

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists, so this file has no `@AGENTS.md` line.
- Whether a GPUParticles2D emits `finished` headlessly, where no particle process runs
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6); Rule A5 frees bursts on `finished`.

- `Curve.max_value` is the brief's name for the range; not yet read back on 4.7.2.

# CLAUDE.md — Mimic Keep

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2 stable, `4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf` (README.md:18);
  `config/features` lists `"4.7"` and `"Forward Plus"` (godot/project.godot:16).
- **Renderer:** Forward+, the default, so `rendering_method` is absent from godot/project.godot
  (README.md:19-20). No HDR 2D key (godot/project.godot:51-53). 1280×720, stretch `canvas_items`
  (:20-22). Main scene `res://game/main.tscn` (:15).

### Effect A — Arrow Impact Burst: two GPUParticles2D, flash A1 + straw A2 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3)
- Event owner: `Scarecrow.hit(damage, element)` (godot/game/scarecrow.gd:33-39), called only from
  godot/game/arrow.gd:22 when an arrow is within `ARROW_HIT_RADIUS` 26 px (godot/game/tuning.gd:15).
- `signal hit_taken(position: Vector2)` **does not exist yet**; the brief allows adding it and emitting
  `global_position` between scarecrow.gd:38 (`ignite()`) and :39 (`_check_death()`) (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5).
- A lethal hit: `_check_death()` removes the group, emits `died`, `queue_free()`s (scarecrow.gd:70-74).
- Appears in: one new burst scene per hit under a new Node2D `World/Effects` after `World/Archer`
  (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §5). Today `World` holds `Enemies`, `Arrows`, `Archer` (godot/game/main.tscn:19-26);
  `reset()` frees only Enemies and Arrows children (godot/game/main.gd:36-40). Fire interval 0.6 s
  (tuning.gd:10).

### Effect B — Burning Embers: two GPUParticles2D, embers B1 + smoke B2 (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3)
- Condition owner: `godot/game/scarecrow.gd` (class `Scarecrow`, line 1). Signals `burning_started`,
  `burning_ended`, `died` (lines 8-10); `var burn_time_left: float` (line 16); `is_burning()` is
  `burn_time_left > 0.0` (lines 25-26).
- `ignite()` sets `burn_time_left = Tuning.BURN_DURATION` and emits `burning_started` only when not
  already burning (lines 42-46): a refresh emits nothing. Counted down in `_physics_process`; at
  ≤ `BURN_END_EPSILON` (line 13) set to 0 and `burning_ended` emitted (lines 49-59). Death while
  burning emits `died`, never `burning_ended` (lines 60, 70-74).
- `BURN_DURATION := 4.0`, `BURN_DPS := 4.0` (godot/game/tuning.gd:26-27).
- Appears in: every scarecrow. `godot/game/scarecrow.tscn` = root `Scarecrow` (Node2D) + child `Sprite`
  (Sprite2D, local-to-scene ShaderMaterial on Rui's `burning_tint.gdshader`, driver `burning_tint.gd`)
  (scarecrow.tscn:8-18); instanced by `Game.spawn_scarecrow()` into `World/Enemies` (main.gd:10, 51-57).
  Game end sets `World.process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED` (main.gd:95); `reset()` restores it (:47).
- Not present yet: `godot/effects/`, its `textures/*.png` and `godot/tools/make_particle_textures.gd` (brief §3).

### Tests — always through scripts/run-test.sh, from the repository root
`scripts/run-test.sh <test-file.gd> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]` (scripts/run-test.sh:2) runs
`godot --headless [--fixed-fps <fps>] --path godot --script res://tests/<file>` under `timeout`
(default 120 s), tees to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log`, and exits 1 on a non-zero exit or a log line with
`SHADER ERROR` / `SCRIPT ERROR` (lines 3-14). **Realtime mode:** `realtime` as the second argument
drops `--fixed-fps` and logs to `logs/<name>_realtime.log` (lines 5-6, 10); it is still headless (line 11).

```bash
godot --headless --path godot --import          # after a fresh clone or a deleted godot/.godot (README.md:57)
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_rules.gd 60        # also test_input, test_materials, normal_map_check at 60
bash scripts/run-test.sh test_burning_tint.gd 30 # and 60, 144; test_wall_targeting.gd the same
bash scripts/run-test.sh <test>.gd realtime 180  # realtime mode, 180 s timeout
```
- A6 baseline (commit 056bcc0, evidence/a6-baseline/): test_rules 23/0, test_input 14/0,
  test_materials 132/0, normal_map_check 9/0 at 60; test_burning_tint 49/0, test_wall_targeting 10/0
  at 30/60/144. One PASS/FAIL line per check, exit 1 on failure (godot/tests/test_rules.gd:2-4, 34-35).
  Real keys go through `Input.parse_input_event` (godot/tests/test_input.gd:2, 51).
- State tests drive real arrows and keys, never `hit()`, `ignite()` or an effect trigger directly; a
  feedback test may set `burn_time_left` (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6).

### Headless facts (probed on this machine, Godot 4.7.2)
- Headless is a dummy renderer that draws nothing: no headless test can judge how a particle looks
  or moves (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §6). Physics runs at 60 ticks/s whatever `--fixed-fps` says.
- Probed 2026-11-05 (FRICTIONAL.md:554-561): GPUParticles2D has `amount_ratio`, `use_fixed_seed`,
  `seed`, `finished`; CPUParticles2D has no `amount_ratio` and no turbulence. A `Curve` defaults to
  0–1 and silently stores 1.2 as 1.0. `direction` defaults to (1, 0, 0), `particle_flag_disable_z` to false.
- `godot` on PATH is a shim in `~/bin` (outside the repo) to the portable 4.7.2 console build.

## Current change

@CHANGE-BRIEF.md

## Ownership

Files in `godot/shaders/` are hand-written by the human (Rui) and are never edited by an agent —
not created, modified, renamed, reformatted or deleted. If a shader looks wrong, report it and stop.
`scripts/check-session.sh` verifies after each session that `godot/shaders/` and
`scripts/run-test.sh` are unchanged (scripts/check-session.sh:29-33).

Effect settings (every value in CHANGE-BRIEF.md §3) live in scene files in `godot/effects/`, with
their ParticleProcessMaterial and CanvasItemMaterial as sub-resources, not in code. Driver scripts
only toggle `emitting`, set `amount_ratio`, reparent and free.

## Godot 4 names

Use Godot 4.7.2 names, never Godot 3 ones: `Particles2D` → **GPUParticles2D**, `ParticlesMaterial` →
**ParticleProcessMaterial**, `GradientTexture` → **GradientTexture1D**, `flag_disable_z` →
**`particle_flag_disable_z`**, a single `initial_velocity` / `scale` / `damping` / `angle` → **`_min`/`_max`**.
In 4.7.2 `initial_velocity` and `scale` still exist as editor-only Vector2 ranges that are not stored;
a float assigned to them is silently ignored (FRICTIONAL.md:556-558).
- Node: `amount`, `amount_ratio`, `emitting`, `one_shot`, `explosiveness`, `lifetime`, `preprocess`,
  `local_coords`, `visibility_rect`, `texture`, `process_material`, `material`; signal `finished`.
- ParticleProcessMaterial: `emission_shape` (`EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE`/`_BOX`), `emission_sphere_radius`,
  `emission_box_extents`, `direction`, `spread`, `gravity` (Vector3), `initial_velocity_min/max`,
  `damping_min/max`, `scale_min/max`, `angle_min/max`, `color_ramp`, `scale_curve` (CurveTexture),
  `turbulence_enabled`, `turbulence_influence_min/max`, `particle_flag_disable_z`.
- Blend: `CanvasItemMaterial.blend_mode` = `BLEND_MODE_ADD` / `BLEND_MODE_MIX`.
- Only the facts cited above were probed; the rest is the 4.x API, unverified on 4.7.2. Read a property
  back with `get_property_list()` before relying on it; if it is missing, report it, don't guess.

## Out of scope

- Game rules: HP, damage, burn length or DPS, the burn timer, movement, targeting, fire rate, arrow
  flight and hit detection, gate damage, spawning, win/loss, pause, restart, the input map. Effect
  code reads `burn_time_left`, `is_burning()` and signals; it never writes game state.
- In `scarecrow.gd`, anything beyond one `hit_taken` signal and its one emit, or reordering damage,
  `ignite()` and `_check_death()`. In `main.tscn`, anything beyond the one `World/Effects` node.
- Editing `tuning.gd`, `main.gd`, `archer.gd`, `arrow.gd`, `project.godot`, any existing test or
  `scripts/run-test.sh`; loosening an existing test expectation.
- Changing `amount` at runtime instead of `amount_ratio`; reusing one one-shot burst node; parenting a
  burst to the scarecrow; CPUParticles2D for either effect.
- The Assignment 5 work (burning tint, shield room, hint experiment) and every existing sprite and
  texture. Particles on anything but the scarecrow and its hits.
- GDD systems not in this change (gold, XP, level-ups, shop, other elements, bosses) (README.md:133-134).

## Unconfirmed

- No `AGENTS.md` exists, so this file has no `@AGENTS.md` line.
- Whether `finished` fires headlessly, where no particle process runs (brief §6); Rule A5 relies on it.
- Whether live particles survive reparenting on death (Rule B4) and whether a hidden emitter keeps
  simulating (Rule B6): still predictions (FRICTIONAL.md:585-587).
- The brief sets no frame rates for the new effect tests; its §7 strips are captured at 30 fps.
- Names of the burst scene, the B emitter scene and their driver scripts are not in the brief.
- `Curve.max_value` is the brief's name for the range; not yet read back on 4.7.2.

The sections are in the order you asked for. There is no `@AGENTS.md` line because `AGENTS.md` doesn't exist.

The file notes that re-igniting a burning scarecrow emits no signal, and a burning scarecrow that dies emits `died` but never `burning_ended`.
  - **Tests:** all run through `run-test.sh`. Its realtime mode, `run-test.sh <test> realtime [timeout]`, drops `--fixed-fps` and logs to `logs/<name>_realtime.log`, but it still runs headless. The section also lists the A6 baseline results (commit `056bcc0`).

- **Unconfirmed:** the open questions in the next paragraph, plus two gaps in the brief: it sets no frame rates for the new tests, and it doesn't name the effect scenes or their scripts.
